Dropping the call changes no state.

aisef/harness/testlog.py::_js_import_errors `importer.endswith(f) and f != importer` -> `or`: `f` is either a failed file the importer ends with, or the importer itself, so `importer.endswith(f)` is always True; when f == importer the original gives "" and the mutant gives importer[:-len(importer)] == "" — identical in every reachable state.
